In the game, a character with long black hair and a cream dress stands in a dark room with red walls and wall-mounted lamps. The real-life creator has long dark hair, wearing a dark top, and is seen in a dimly lit indoor setting reacting to the game. The game character remains stationary, though the camera angle in the game shifts slightly closer to her face. (3) The creator continues to laugh and speak toward her monitor, while the game character stands still. The background of the creator's room shows glimpses of a computer setup and soft indoor lighting. The game scene maintains a high-contrast cinematic lighting style, emphasizing the eerie atmosphere of the virtual room.
